title: Dual Boolean function
statement: For a Boolean function $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, define its dual by $f^*(x)=-f(-x)$, where $-x$ negates every coordinate of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
